sections.title: Mental model — explicit machines for implicit calls

blocks.md: **Recursion uses the call stack invisibly; iterative versions just make that stack EXPLICIT. Same walks, visible plumbing.**

blocks.label: iterative inorder (the interview staple)
blocks.py:
def inorder(root):
    out, st, cur = [], [], root
    while cur or st:
        while cur:                      # dive left
            st.append(cur); cur = cur.left
        cur = st.pop()                  # visit
        out.append(cur.val)
        cur = cur.right                 # switch lane
    return out

blocks.label: Diameter (LC543) + Balanced (LC110) — one-walk forms
blocks.py:
dia = 0
def ht(r):
    global dia
    if not r: return 0
    L, R = ht(r.left), ht(r.right)
    dia = max(dia, L + R)               # path THROUGH this node
    return max(L, R) + 1                # height component
# balanced variant returns -1 sentinel on imbalance
